1.0.0: Components: Send Prompt, Describe Images, Generate Embeddings, Extract Document Text, Create Transcription, Create Speech, Moderate, List Models, List Voices and Make API Call.
Model dropdowns are filtered by model capability so each component only offers models the endpoint accepts.
1.1.0: New AI Agent component: model and instructions on the input port (bindable to flow variables), tools on the 'tool' port - any action component (fields mapped to 'Model Defined Parameter' are filled by the model), a chain of components run as one tool, or an MCP server; no ToolStart/ToolOutput needed. Thread memory with an optional data store, files as context (images to vision models, PDFs through Mistral OCR) and streaming to the chat utility. The model list offers models that support function calling.

Send Prompt: the output now has the same shape as the other AI connectors - Answer, Prompt, ID, Model, Created Timestamp, Finish Reason and Usage as top-level fields. The previous 'choices.message.content' and 'choices.finish_reason' outputs are replaced by 'answer' and 'finishReason'.
